info.title: Credit pipeline API
info.description:
API кредитного конвейера для малого и микробизнеса (прототип, синтетические данные).

* Аутентификация: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, затем заголовок `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
* Команды, меняющие статус заявки, принимают `expected_version` (оптимистичная блокировка) и заголовок `Idempotency-Key`.
* Ошибки в едином формате `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details", "fields"}}`.
* Клиентский API не отдает внутренний статус, балл, грейд и пороги политики: только `client_status` и тексты.

post.description: Login and password of a test account. After 5 failures the login is paused for 1 minute.
Rotate the refresh token (HttpOnly cookie). Reuse of a rotated token revokes the whole family.

patch.description:
UPDATE_DRAFT (autosave). Only the fields present in the body change (null clears a field).

Valid fields are saved even if others fail the format check; those come back in field_errors.

post.description: PREFILL_BY_INN: data from REGISTRY and FNS mocks, early warnings (business age, status, unreliable data).

put.description: GIVE_CONSENT: server time, text version and hash, IP and user agent are recorded.

post.description: UPLOAD_DOCUMENT: PDF, JPG or PNG by signature, up to 10 MB; 20 draft files and a separate quota of 20 per information-request item.
SUBMIT (T-03): full validation, three consents, duplicate check. Requires Idempotency-Key.
RESPOND_INFO (T-10): answers to all required items; FIELD answers change the form with history.
WITHDRAW (T-04, T-11, T-41, T-45).
ACCEPT_OFFER (T-33): the chosen option becomes the final terms; 409 OFFER_EXPIRED after expires_at.
DECLINE_OFFER (T-34, T-38, T-46) with an optional OD_* reason.
REQUEST_SIGNING_CODE: 6 digits, TTL 5 min, previous code revoked, at most 5 per hour. Shown in the product, never sent outside.
SIGN (T-39): valid code bound to the document hashes; a repeated key returns the first result (one loan).

get.description: Text of a generated document (EDO mock) for reading before signing.
Payment schedule of an offer option or of the issued loan (for a credit line: the full limit over the tranche term).

post.description: 'Explain simpler' (optional AI with a deterministic template fallback; numbers are inserted after generation).

get.description: Tabs: queue (MANUAL_REVIEW, by SLA), mine, errors (PROCESSING_ERROR), decided (by me), approval and all (risk manager). Drafts are never shown.

get.description:
Full card: form, registry data, sources with attempts, scoring by factors, policy rules path, decisions, history, audit.
Each opening is written to the access journal (APPLICATION_VIEWED).

post.description: TAKE (T-25). Of two simultaneous takes one wins, the other gets 409 ALREADY_TAKEN.
RELEASE (T-26), assignee only, comment required.
APPROVE on the requested terms (T-27, or T-28 when four eyes are required: above authority limit or override).
MAKE_COUNTER_OFFER: 1-3 options (original product or CREDIT_LINE) within product bounds; rate from the grade matrix.
REQUEST_INFO (T-29): 1-10 structured items with NI_* codes; the application stays pinned to the underwriter.
DECLINE (T-30): reason codes SF_*/DCL_* (except DCL_AFFORDABILITY) and a comment are required.
CONFIRM_DECISION (T-31), risk manager who is not the author of the draft decision.
RETURN_DECISION (T-32) to the same underwriter, comment required.
RETRY_PROCESSING (T-44): back to failed_stage, retry counters reset, the stage task is queued again.
Internal comment, never visible to the client.
